d82d6557-6e6b-47bb-87b4-04dd928def2d.last_title: Rust detector scaffold and SQLite schema design
d82d6557-6e6b-47bb-87b4-04dd928def2d.last_summary: Resolved the detector-language decision (Rust, closing issue #1) and repo layout (single monorepo, closing issue #2), then hand-built a working first-pass scanner that walks /Applications and parses Info.plist for bundle ID/version, explaining Rust fundamentals along the way since this is the user's first Rust project. Designed a five-table SQLite schema (tools, scans, scan_results, usage_events, checkpoints) for the WorkingStore, after which the user chose to take over the ER/LLD diagramming themselves in excalidraw/system.excalidraw as a learning exercise. Also diagnosed a noisy atuin integration hook (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure on the Bash matcher in ~/.claude/settings.json) that fails because atuin isn't installed locally.
d82d6557-6e6b-47bb-87b4-04dd928def2d.last_next_steps: User to finish the schema/ER design themselves in excalidraw/system.excalidraw; then translate it into Rust (rusqlite migration code) for the WorkingStore. Continue building remaining scanners (Homebrew Cellar, cargo, npm).
